items.label: Mid-Century Elegance
items.value: Featuring smooth lines and a minimalist build, this side table emanates a refined mid-century aura, seamlessly fitting any decor. Its naturally textured surface is ideal for showcasing decor or daily items, instantly enhancing home sophistication as a stylish centerpiece

items.label: Ample Storage Space
items.value: This end table, featuring a sliding door, offers a dedicated storage area. It's an excellent spot to stash daily essentials like books, electronics, and other household items. It provides a practical solution to help you maintain a neat, organized, and stylish living environment

items.label: Space - Saving & Versatile
items.value: This compact side table measures 15.74" x 15.74" x 20.47". Its small footprint makes it ideal for placement beside an armchair or sofa. It serves multiple functions as a drinks table, bedside table, or a stylish stand, adding practicality and style to your space

items.label: Robust and Stable Design
items.value: Drawing on the architectural concept of load - bearing columns, we've crafted a table support frame with stable columns to keep the bedside tabletop steady and prevent wobbling. The support legs linked to the frame also effectively provide solid stability for the night stand

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: This side table simplifies installation with minimal hardware use and highly integrated setup steps. Each component comes with clear, concise instructions, ensuring you can complete the assembly process effortlessly within just 30 minutes

items.label: Item Dimensions D X W X H
Special Features
items.value: Easy Assembly, Scratch Resistant, Sliding, Space Saving

items.label: Recommended Number of People for Assembly
Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Attach legs with screws. Tighten using the provided screwdriver. Insert tabletop support brackets into pre-drilled holes. Secure legs to brackets using included hex bolts. Flip table upright once all connections are secure.
